z-m-16-01.title: Ingabe isisho esinikeza inombolo eyinhloko noma yiyiphi inombolo oyifaka ku-n?
z-m-16-01.topic: Izinombolo eziyinhloko nezixubile, amanani ezisho ezinezinhlamvu
z-m-16-01.goal: Funda ukuthi ukuba lungile izikhathi eziningi akuqinisekisi 'njalo,' lungisa ukuthi uqinisekile kangakanani ukuze kuhambisane nedatha, bese uthola wena isibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-16-01.material: Umngani weklabhu yezibalo uthe, "Uma n iyinombolo ephelele engu-0 noma ngaphezulu, njenge-0, 1, 2, ..., inani le-n×n+n+41 (n izikhathi n kuhlanganiswe no-n kuhlanganiswe no-41) lihlala liyinombolo eyinhloko!" Inombolo eyinhloko iyinombolo engu-2 okungenani futhi izihlukanisi zayo kuphela ngu-1 nayo ngokwayo, futhi inombolo engu-2 okungenani engeyona eyinhloko iyinombolo exubile.

z-m-16-01.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ukuthi uqinisekile kangakanani ngokwedatha entsha

z-m-16-01.prereq.1: Ukufaka inombolo esikhundleni sohlamvu n ukuthola inani lesisho (n×n ngu-n squared)
z-m-16-01.prereq.2: Ukubala ngokuhlukanisa izinombolo zamadijithi amane ngokuphezulu ngezincane ngokulandelana

z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Uma ufaka n=1, 2, 3, 4, 5, amanani angu-43, 47, 53, 61, 71. Zonke ezinhlanu ziyizinombolo eziyinhloko.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucabanga ini manje ngesicelo somngani wakho?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuhlolwa okuhlanu kuyisikhombisi esisekela isicelo. Kodwa kunama-n angapheli, ngakho ukusho 'njalo,' udinga ukuhlola kabanzi noma uthole isizathu.

z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Zonke ezingu-40 bezingama-prime, ngakho manje singasho 'njalo i-prime'

z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ingxenye oyihloliwe ayisona yonke. Kusekhona ingxenye engahlolwanga.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Uma ufaka u-n=40, uthola 40×40+40+41=1681. Kodwa 41×41 nawo ungu-1681.

z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1681=41×41 akuyona inombolo ye-prime. Isibonelo esisodwa sikhombisa ukuthi 'njalo i-prime' ayisebenzi.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Abokuqala abangu-40 bonke babe ngama-prime, ngakho ukubala kwe-n=40 kumele kube kungalungile
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uma uthandabuza ukubala, ungabala futhi. Akumele ulahle umphumela omusha ngoba nje imiphumela yangaphambili iningi.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kusukela manje, kumele sithi izinombolo ezihlanganisiwe zivela kuwo wonke u-n
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wenze isiphetho esibanzi kakhulu ohlangothini oluphambene. Ukuthola icala elilodwa akwenzi wonke amacala abe ngaphezu.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: U-n=40 kuphela uyisiphetho, ngakho singasho ukuthi iyi-prime kunamaningi ka-n
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 'Amaningi' nawo awakahlolwa. Udinga ukuthola ukuthi izinombolo ezihlanganisiwe zivela yini no-n=41 nangemva kwalokho.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Inombolo ehlanganisiwe ivele ku-n=40, ngakho 'njalo i-prime' ayilungile
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wazile ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa siphula 'njalo,' futhi wamukela umphumela omusha njengoba unjalo.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.reflect: Ukuqiniseka kwakho kushintshe kanjani lapho imiphumela ifika kuze kube ku-n=5, kuze kube ku-39, bese ku-n=40? Yini ehlukile phakathi kokuqongelelana kwezibonelo ezilungile nokuvela kwesibonelo esisodwa esingalungile?
z-m-16-01.s.s2.prompt: Thola amanani ama-2 ahlukile ka-n, u-n eyinombolo ephelele kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100, lapho inani lika-n×n+n+41 lingeyona i-prime (liyi-composite), bese uwafaka.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuze kube ku-n=39 zonke bezingama-prime. Bala amanani ngokulandelana kusukela ku-n olandelayo.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.hint.1: Uma inani likhulu, hlola ukuthi lihlukaniseka ngo-2, 3, 5, 7, ... ngalokho kulandelana yini.

z-m-16-01.s.s2.fail.c1: n akuyona inombolo ephelele kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kulo n inani liyi-prime. Funa enye n.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.explain: Ku-n=40 kungu-1681=41×41, ku-n=41 kungu-41×41+41+41=1763=41×43, futhi ku-n=44 kungu-2021=43×47, ngakho izinombolo ezihlanganisiwe ziyavela. Noma amacala angu-40 ayelungile, isibonelo esiphikisayo savela ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.prompt: Ufuna ukutshela umngane wakho weqembu lakho lokuthi: "Noma bekuyi-prime kuwo wonke u-n kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-39, akumele usho 'njalo i-prime'." Bhala isizathu, usebenzisa okungenani inani elilodwa lika-n olitholile ngenhla.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale phansi u-n oyedwa owuthole ngenhla nomphumela wokubala kuwo.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khomba ukuthi lowo mphumela uphikisana nasiphi isiqu (' njalo') sesitatimende somngane wakho.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe kucacile ukuthi inani alisiyo i-prime ku-n owunikeze?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe kufaka iphuzu lokuthi 'ngihlolile kakhulu' no-'ngihlolile wonke amacala' kuyahluka?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uthe ngisho nesibonelo esisodwa siphula 'njalo'?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.0: Ku-n=40, 1681=41×41, ngakho akuyona i-prime. Noma amanani angu-40 ayeyi-prime, uma kuvela u-n owodwa kuphela onjalo, 'njalo i-prime' kuba ngalungile.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.1: Noma uhlola kangakanani, awukahloli wonke u-n. Eqinisweni ku-n=41 uthola 41×43=1763, inombolo ehlanganisiwe, ngakho akumele usho 'njalo.'
z-m-16-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Iqukethe kokubili imibono: isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo, no-'okuphelele, hhayi inani.'

z-m-16-02.title: Lapho amabhasi amabili emuka ndawonye okokuqala ngokulandelayo
z-m-16-02.topic: Ukusebenzisa izinombolo eziphindaphindiwe nezinombolo eziphindaphindiwe ezifanayo
z-m-16-02.goal: Hlukanisa inani elisebenza ngokuhlanganyela nenani elisebenza 'okokuqala', dizayina wena amabhangqa ezikhawu afanela imibandela, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani amacala angenakwenzeka engenakwenzeka.
z-m-16-02.material: Esiteshini sebhasi esisodwa, ibhasi lomzila 가 lemuka njalo ngemizuzu eyi-12 futhi ibhasi lomzila 나 lemuka njalo ngemizuzu eyi-18. Namuhla ngo-9 ekuseni ngqo amabhasi amabili emuke ndawonye, futhi ngemva kwalokho umzila ngamunye ugcina isikhawu sawo ngqo futhi uqhubeka nokuhamba. UHarin uthe, "Ngemva kwemizuzu eyi-12×18=216, ukuphindaphinda izikhawu ezimbili, okungukuthi, ngo-12:36 ntambama, azohamba ndawonye futhi okokuqala!"
z-m-16-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yezinombolo eziphindaphindiwe, nokubhala izinombolo eziphindaphindiwe zenombolo ngokulandelana
z-m-16-02.prereq.1: Ukubala ngezikhathi zamahora nemizuzu (ukuguqula imizuzu ibe isikhathi sosuku)
z-m-16-02.s.s1.prompt: Ubheke lokho uHarin akushilo. Khetha ukuhlolwa okufaneleka kakhulu.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izikhathi (ngemizuzu) lapho umzila 가 uhamba khona, njengo-12, 24, ..., bese ubhala umzila 나 ngokwehlukana.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.1: Thola zonke izikhathi ezivela kuyo yomibili imigqa bese uhlola ukuthi yisiphi esisheshayo kakhulu.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.a: Ngemva kwemizuzu eyi-12+18=30, isamba sezikhawu ezimbili, yilapho behamba ndawonye futhi okokuqala
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuthi umzila 가 uhamba ngemva kwemizuzu engu-30. Umzila 가 uhamba ngezikhawu zemizuzu eyi-12.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.b: Behamba ndawonye okokuqala ngemva kwemizuzu eyi-18, isikhawu eside
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.b: Umzila 나 uhamba ngemva kwemizuzu eyi-18. Hlola ukuthi umzila 가 uhamba ngemizuzu eyi-18 yini.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.c: Ngemva kwemizuzu engu-216 kulungile. Isikhathi esitholwa ngokuphindaphinda izikhawu ezimbili yilapho behamba ndawonye okokuqala.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.c: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi yomibili imizila ihamba ngenombolo ephindaphindiwe. Kodwa ingabe uhlolile ukuthi akukho isikhathi sangaphambili lapho behamba khona ndawonye?
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.d: Bahamba ndawonye nangemva kwemizuzu engu-216, kodwa kukhona isikhathi sangaphambili, ngakho akuyona 'eyokuqala'
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.d: Uhlukanise 'isikhathi lapho yomibili imizila ihamba' no-'isikhathi sokuqala lapho yomibili imizila ihamba.'
z-m-16-02.s.s1.explain: Izinombolo eziphindaphindiwe zika-12 ngu-12, 24, 36, ... nezinombolo eziphindaphindiwe zika-18 ngu-18, 36, 54, ..., ngakho bahamba ndawonye okokuqala ngemva kwemizuzu engu-36 (ngo-9:36). Imizuzu engu-216 ingu-6 izikhathi ezingu-36, ngakho bahamba ndawonye nangaleso sikhathi, kodwa akuyona isikhathi 'sokuqala'.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.prompt: Nakhu uhlelo lwemizila emisha. Imizila emibili ihamba ndawonye ngo-9 ekuseni, futhi isikhathi esilandelayo lapho bahamba ndawonye okokuqala kuzoba ngo-9:36 (imizuzu engu-36 kamuva). Nquma isikhawu somzila 가 imizuzu a nesikhawu somzila 나 imizuzu b. a no-b ziyizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-36, futhi a kumele ibe incane kuno-b. Thola (a, b) ezi-3 ezahlukile.

(12, 18) yisimo sokuqala. Amabhangqa ahlangana ngesikhathi sangaphambili kuno-36 ((6, 9) ahlangana ngemizuzu eyi-18) noma amabhangqa angafinyeleli ku-36 ((5, 7) ahlangana ngemizuzu engu-35) awahambisani nemibandela.

z-m-16-02.s.s3.model.0: Akunakwenzeka. Umzila 나 uhamba ngemizuzu engu-0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, ngakho awuhambi ngemizuzu engu-36. Lokhu kungoba u-36 akuyona inombolo eyaphindaphindwa ka-8.

z-m-16-03.title: Ukuthola izinga lezinombolo ezigcwele ezilandelanayo isamba sazo singu-10
z-m-16-03.goal: Sebenzisa isici sokuthi izinombolo eziphambene zihlangana zibe ngu-0 ezambeni zezinombolo ezigcwele ezilandelanayo ezixuba ezinhle nezimbi, ukuze uthole amazinga amaningana afanela imibandela bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
z-m-16-03.material: Yeka 'S(s, e)' ibe yinani elitholwa ngokwengeza zonke izinombolo ezigcwele linye ngalinye kusukela enombolweni egcwele s kuya ku-e (s iyinombolo egcwele engeyona enkulu kuno-e). z-m-16-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala zonke izinombolo kusukela ku-−3 kuya ku-5 bese uxhuma ngemigqa izinombolo ezinenani eliphelele elifanayo.

z-m-16-10.title: Singasho ukuthi ukujiya kwephepha elilinganiswe ngerula kuyalingana ngqo?
z-m-16-10.goal: Ucabangela ukuthi amanani alinganisiwe anephutha, hlulela 'ingabe kungaba ukulingana ngqo noma ezilinganiso zingafani ncamashi?', hlela ukuthi idatha entsha iyavumelana yini nemodeli, bese uhlela ukuthi uzohlola kanjani kakhudlwana.
z-m-16-10.material:
Ubeke amashidi angu-x ephepha elifanayo futhi, usebenzisa irula enezimpawu zika-1mm, ufunde uphawu oluseduze kakhulu wabhala ukujiya y mm. Kuthiwa inani elifundiwe lihluka ekujiyeni kwangempela ngo-0.5mm noma ngaphansi. Cabanga ukuthi lonke iphepha liyafana futhi alihlutshwa uma libekwe.
Ithebula (inani lamashidi x → ukujiya okufundiwe y): amashidi angu-100 → 10mm, amashidi angu-200 → 21mm, amashidi angu-300 → 31mm, amashidi angu-400 → 41mm.
Amanani ka-y÷x ayi-0.1, 0.105, cishe 0.1033, nocishe 0.1025.

z-m-16-10.s.s1.r.a: Wahlulele ukhulula iphutha. Kuqina uma uhlola ukuthi isilinganiso esisodwa singawachaza ngempela wonke amanani amane.

z-m-16-10.s.s1.o.d: y nayo ikhula nge-x, ngakho noma yisiphi isilinganiso, kungenzeka kube ukulingana ngqo
z-m-16-10.s.s1.r.d: Ukukhula ndawonye kuphela akwenzi ukulingana ngqo. Kumele futhi uhlole ukuthi isilinganiso sihlala sinjalo yini.
